principles: count_tokens is a pluggable injected interface — the module stays decoupled (zero cross-module imports)
Local fallback is a coarse bytes/chars heuristic, never tiktoken, clearly low-confidence
Reuse assemble/record/ids in-module; estimate is source=prompt-size-estimate and NEVER final usage
Bind every estimate to the exact model id (counts are model-version-specific)
drivers: User asked to keep the module independent and chose the low-risk estimate path first
Estimates guard preflight budget decisions but must never be mistaken for billing truth
A pluggable count_tokens keeps the high-confidence path correct without coupling to a provider client now

options.name: A: estimate.ts with an injected count_tokens + concrete bytes/chars fallback
pros: High-confidence path correct once injected later

options.name: B: call a real provider count_tokens here
cons: Couples the ledger to a provider HTTP client; not testable offline; higher risk — rejected

chosen: A: estimate.ts with an injected count_tokens + concrete bytes/chars fallback
rationale: An injected count_tokens keeps the module decoupled and unit-testable while making the high-confidence path correct-by-contract for the later dispatch slice to plug in; the always-available bytes/chars fallback makes the estimate path usable (coarsely) from day one.

preMortem.scenario: count_tokens hardcoded to a provider client, coupling the module
preMortem.mitigation: count_tokens injected only; smoke greps that the module imports zero other Lattice modules; only concrete estimator is local bytes/chars

preMortem.scenario: bytes/chars estimate mistaken for billing truth
preMortem.consequence: A coarse guess treated as real usage
preMortem.mitigation: confidence='low', source='prompt-size-estimate'; summary excludes it from final totals; smoke asserts it never counts as provider-reported
buildSupersedes wiring + summary exclusion; smoke asserts a superseded estimate is not in providerReportedTotal

preMortem.scenario: estimate record rejected by the validator
preMortem.mitigation: buildEstimateRecord sets estimator{name,version,unit,confidence}; output=null is already allowed for prompt-size-estimate; smoke asserts validates

preMortem.scenario: tiktoken pulled in for local counting
preMortem.consequence: Wrong counts for Claude + a new dependency
preMortem.mitigation: Explicit bytes/chars heuristic, no tokenizer dependency; documented why
